subject: Post-call: renewal pricing & volume step-up — blended-rate options
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@finnova.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@finnova.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-15T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: renewal pricing & volume step-up — blended-rate options

Hi Alex / Priya — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps on the pricing side so we stay aligned before I put together a formal SOW/term sheet.

Recap (from our discovery)
- Current monthly usage: ~2.8M tokens (generation + embeddings).
- Expect ramp: 3–4x over next 12 months driven by new translation route + reranker model.
- Renewal window: June 1 effective date for the next 12 months.
- Primary ask: reduced unit economics at scale (target blended $/1M tokens) and a clear step-up schedule for committed volumes.

Questions I promised to confirm
1) Target blended rate: you mentioned a target in the neighborhood of $650–750 per 1M tokens for blended traffic — can you confirm whether that is an absolute cap or a budget target you can stretch for additional features?
2) Volume bands: please confirm expected monthly token bands after ramp (e.g., 0–5M, 5–15M, 15M+). We used a rough forecast on the call but I want concrete numbers to model blended rates.
3) Routes/models to include: confirm which routes should be included in the blended calculation (generation, embeddings, translations, reranker). We typically exclude highly specialized third-party models unless you want them in the bundle.

Attached: preliminary pricing workbook (finnova-pricing-v3.xlsx) with three blending scenarios and worked examples. Ill draft a short SOW once you confirm the bands and target blended $/1M token.

Proposed next steps
- You send confirmed monthly bands and whether translations + reranker are included (reply by EOD Thursday 3/18).
- I send a pro-forma SOW + final blended-rate table (target: 2 business days after your numbers).
- If fine, we move to DocuSign and target a June 1 effective date.

If helpful I can include a simple example calculation in the SOW showing how billings move between committed discount tiers vs. overage at list rates.

Thanks — Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer

Subject: Re: Post-call: renewal pricing & volume step-up — blended-rate options

Karthik — thanks for the recap and the workbook. Quick answers inline below.

On 3/15/26 09:07, Karthik Iyer wrote:
> Recap (from our discovery)
> - Current monthly usage: ~2.8M tokens (generation + embeddings).
> - Expect ramp: 3–4x over next 12 months driven by new translation route + reranker model.
> - Renewal window: June 1 effective date for the next 12 months.
> - Primary ask: reduced unit economics at scale (target blended $/1M tokens) and a clear step-up schedule for committed volumes.

Confirmations:
- Target blended rate: $700 per 1M tokens is our internal target. Thats more a budget constraint than a hard cap — we could stretch up to $775 for a package that includes reranker and translation paths.
- Volume bands (expected after Q3 ramp): 0–5M, 5–20M, 20M+. Were forecasting 12M avg/month by month 9.
- Include in-blend: generation, embeddings, translations; exclude large third-party LLM (we still evaluate the vendor model separately). Reranker: include if the latency SLA is within 100ms p50; otherwise wed like it billed as a separate add-on.

Wed like to see two options in the SOW: (A) firm committed bands with blended pricing and (B) committed bands + buffer credits with lower overage. Also please include example yearly spend for our forecasted bands.

Im copying Priya for procurement — well need the final SOW + pricing table for our procurement review.

Thanks,
Alex

Alex Moreno
Director of ML Platform | Finnova Health
alex.moreno@finnova.com | (212) 555-0104
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@finnova.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@finnova.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-15T13:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: renewal pricing & volume step-up — blended-rate options

Alex — perfect, thanks for the clarity. Based on your targets and bands I put together two clean options below (also reflected in the attached SOW draft):

Option A — Committed blended tiers (simpler billing)
- 0–5M: $1,200 per 1M tokens (list/low-commit tier)
- 5–20M: $850 per 1M tokens
- 20M+: $650 per 1M tokens
- Blended example: if monthly = 12M (5M @1200 + 7M @850) => blended = $953 per 1M tokens; with a 12-month commit we can reduce the 20M+ tier to $600/1M which brings blended down ~6% on your forecast.

Option B — Committed + buffer credits (preferred by many customers)
- Commit bands as above but with 10% buffer credits at the top of each band (unconsumed buffer rolls forward for one quarter).
- Overage billing: over buffer billed at list tier (no surprise credits).
- Example: for 12M target, we can offer blended = $900 per 1M tokens with a 12-month commit + 10% buffer and the 20M+ deep-discount at $600/1M.

Reranker handling
- If you can accept p50 <= 100ms within your region we include reranker in the blended calculation. If not, reranker billed as a separate per-call unit with its own discount tiers (we can include both lines on the SOW).

Next steps
1) Ill attach a short SOW (finnova-sow-v2.pdf) that encodes Option A + Option B side-by-side plus worked spend examples for 12/24-month terms.
2) Please confirm which option you prefer and whether reranker is in-blend by EOD Friday 3/19.
3) Once approved by Alex/Priya we will produce a final SOW and send via DocuSign for signature.

I added a worked example in the SOW showing total annual spend at $700 blended vs. $900 blended so procurement can see delta for budget planning.

Thanks — Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer

Well proceed as follows:
- Priya (procurement) to review SOW and run standard terms — target: review complete by 3/24.
- Legal to review limited indemnity clause and data residency note; will flag changes if any.
- Finance prefers the Option B structure with buffer credits (helps smoothing).

Please go ahead and send the final SOW with Option B highlighted and a DocuSign link; well aim to sign before the end of May for a June 1 start.

Thanks — Priya
